product_metadata.title: 5pack Halloween Decorations Tablecloth Runner Black Lace Round Spider Cobweb Table Cover Fireplace Mantel Scarf Spiderweb Fireplace Scarf Spider Lampshade with 36pcs Scary 3D Bat for Halloween Party
features: BLACK LACE MATERIAL:Halloween decorations set are made of high quality polyester, it is soft, lightweight, anti-crease and durable in use, you can use the lace fireplace mantel scarf, Halloween spider web tablecloth and 3D Bat wall stickers to decorate your home kitchen party.

SUPER BIG SIZE:Halloween fireplace scarf runner is 18x96inch which is big enough to cover most size of fireplace; Halloween table runner black is 72 inch long and 18 inch wide; black Halloween lace round tablecloth is 40inch in diameter, you can use it to decor your round table; lamp shade Halloween has a size of 20x60inch, big enough for your to decor your lamp on Halloween and help to add a amazing Halloween atmosphere.

UNIQUE AND BEAUTIFUL DESIGN:Halloween spider lampshade and round cobweb tablecloth in not just a simple lace web cover, it has beautiful pattern, lifelike spiders and stars patterns. There are also 36pcs 3D bats come with 4 different sizes, also easy to use.

COMPLETE FULL SCARY HALLOWEEN DECORATION SET:You will get 1pcs fireplace mantel scarf cover(18x96inch), 1 pcs Halloween rectangular tablecloth ( 18 x 72 inch), 1 pcs Halloween lace round tablecloth(40inch), 1pcs Halloween spider lampshade(20x60inch) and 36pcs scary 3D bat wall stickers(4 different sizes). This is a complete Halloween decor set that you can get everything you want in only one package.

A NECESSITY FOR HALLOWEEN:Halloween indoor decor set are a necessity for Halloween, Black lace spider web table cover, round cobweb tablecloth, cobweb fireplace scarf and Halloween lamp shade can be use to decor your window, table, fireplace, kitchen, yard, mantle or any other places, you can also use the 3D bat to decor the wall. All these Halloween party decoration supplies will help to create a cool and scary festival atmosphere. You can also use them on other theme parties.
